title: Add missing tags: ['story_5_2'] to the Story 5.2 group in epic_05_stages_order_test.dart
why: Every other numbered Story group across all 10 files in this batch carries `tags: ['story_N_M']` per the documented convention ('tags: ["story_1_2"] on each group'); Story 5.2 alone omits it. make test-story-5.2 still works today because its Makefile target filters by `--name "Story 5.2"` rather than `--tags`, so this is not currently a functional break, but any future tooling that filters by tag (CI matrix, `dart test --tags`) silently drops all of Story 5.2's tests.
recommendation: Add `tags: ['story_5_2']` to the group() call, matching every sibling group in the file.
